title: Fundamental Groups of Arbitrary Two-Cell Attachments
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: The full arbitrary-family two-cell attachment theorem for ordinary topological fundamental groups. For any path-connected topological space X, any basepoint, and any indexed family of continuous circle attaching maps, a genuine adjunction quotient is constructed from X and the coproduct of closed complex unit disks. The actual inclusion-induced fundamental-group homomorphism is surjective and its kernel is precisely the normal closure of the once-around attaching loops, transported along the specified basepoint paths.
